senses.definition: vb. insert, thrust in (Arabic غَلَّ whence غُلٌّ yoke; cf. Old Aramaic עלל, 𝔗 עֲלַל, Syriac ܥܰܠ, all enter);—only Pōʿ. Pf. 1 s. וְעֹלַלְתִּי בֶעָפָר קַרְנִי Jb 16:15 fig. of humiliation.
